Storage: Lots. We have a lot of documents and claims data.
page_texts.15:
[resources/work-templates/assets/sales/examples/scr-bad-example.md#5-disaster-recovery--availability]

## 5. Disaster Recovery & Availability

**Selected:** 99.99% (~52.6 minutes downtime/year) — Multi-Region

**Selected DR:** Backup & Restore

We need the highest availability but want to keep costs low. Backup and restore should be fine for DR.

| Requirement | Details |
| --- | --- |
| **Recovery Time Objective (RTO)** | Instant |
| **Recovery Point Objective (RPO)** | Zero data loss |
| **Region Separation** | Doesn't matter |
| **DR Site Hosting** | Same region is fine |
| **Backup Retention Period** | Keep everything forever |
| **DR Testing Frequency** | When we get around to it |
